_note:
Pages the cell-count assignment sent to rio-1883-vento because the reader returned FIFTEEN cells, which is the hourly wind table's count. They are not wind: the codes C, K, N, S are cloud forms. Nor are they a layout this project lacks - they are ordinary NEBULOSITE pages (`Data | 4h M. | ... | 10h S. | Moyenne`, sixteen columns, a tenths-of-sky figure paired with the forms seen at each hour), checked against the scan of doc 8 page 98. rio-1883-nebulosite describes them exactly.

They are listed here to be re-produced under that profile, not to wait for a new one.
